title: Top-level Int64 and Uint64 serialize to JSON numbers and reject strings, diverging from SEP-51
severity_basis: Int64 and Uint64 are generated as type aliases, so the NumberOrString handling of 64-bit fields and newtype typedefs does not apply: converting the types themselves gives bare JSON numbers and refuses the SEP-51 string form, and the JS binding loses precision through JSON.parse without an error. Every 64-bit value inside another type is already a string (the issue states impact low).
caps_note: No CAP applies: the SEP-51 XDR-JSON text form of Int64 and Uint64, not a protocol change.

entries.expected: Int64 and Uint64 converted by type name serialize to JSON strings and accept the string form (SEP-51)
entries.observed: No corpus entry converts Int64 or Uint64 on their own. By hand on 30.0.0: serde_json gives 9223372036854775807 and 18446744073709551615 (bare numbers) and refuses "5"; TimePoint and SequenceNumber give strings.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's Rust program on stellar-xdr 30.0.0 (main ebec5fb the same) and its JS snippet on @stellar/stellar-xdr-json 30.0.0: Uint64 2^53+1 decodes to a bare number that re-encodes as 2^53.
evidence.expected_basis: SEP-51 maps hyper and unsigned hyper to JSON strings; its example for hyper is f/////////8= as "9223372036854775807" (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/ecosystem/sep-0051.md#hyper-integer-64-bit).

reproduction.method: Re-run on 2026-11-18 with the issue's Rust program on stellar-xdr 30.0.0, offline: Int64 and Uint64 print as numbers and refuse "5"; TimePoint and SequenceNumber print as strings.

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-14 as https://github.com/stellar/rs-stellar-xdr/issues/625; this record restates the public issue.

Upstream: a maintainer merged pull request 645 on main on 2026-11-20 (it stops generating the integer typedef types; commit d65093af) and closed the issue as completed; no stellar-xdr release after 30.0.0 includes it yet.
